provenance.sha256_scope: UTF-8 bytes of cmd only; workdir preserved separately
provenance.thread_mapping: Robob #1006 reporter link and reporter activity title confirmed

commands.cmd:
head -35 specs/torcore.totality.json
cat scripts/gradle-tasks.sh
head -55 scripts/check-build.sh
cat > tmp/lifecycle-core/gate.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
expected=$1
actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
[[ "$actual" == "$expected" ]] || { echo 'Wrong gate head'; exit 1; }
[[ -z $(git status --porcelain) ]] || { echo 'Dirty gate inputs'; exit 1; }
echo "GATE_HEAD=$actual"
source scripts/env.sh
bash scripts/bootstrap-offbox.sh --tools-only
# Clear outputs relocated from the skeleton checkout, preserving downloaded caches.
rm -rf build/native app/build torcore/build .gradle
source scripts/gradle-tasks.sh
./gradlew --dependency-verification strict "${TORS_GRADLE_TASKS[@]}"
./scripts/check.sh
[[ $(git rev-parse HEAD) == "$expected" && -z $(git status --porcelain) ]] || { echo 'Gate input changed'; exit 1; }
EOF
